description.narrative: (Democratic Republic of the Congo): Support for strengthened elections and political processes will contribute to freer and fairer elections in the DRC and further establish a culture of democratic electoral reform. With FY 2022 funding, USAID's DRC Electoral Integrity Activity (DEIA) will support the DRC's national electoral commission with the management and organization of the proposed 2023 national elections through training, coaching, and producing organizational resources for electoral staff and poll workers. This activity will also focus on improving civic education, strengthening citizen knowledge and awareness of elections and political processes, empowering communities to participate in elections, and supporting marginalized communities to understand and access these political processes. Another component of this activity will be supporting civil society actors to raise awareness about electoral and political processes and hold the government accountable to promised timelines and procedures surrounding elections..The activity supports Mission Objective 3.1 (Partner with like-minded national and international actors for transparent, inclusive, and timely elections) through technical assistance and training to improve electoral processes, voter education, and civic participation....
